abstract: The International Federation of Robotics' Top 5 Global Robotics Trends 2026 report (January 8, 2026) identifies AI/autonomy, IT/OT integration, humanoid reliability, safety/security, and labor-gap solutions as the year's defining themes. The global market value of industrial robot installations reached an all-time high of US$16.7 billion.
keyFindings: Global industrial robot installation market value at all-time high of US$16.7 billion in 2026
Five trends named: AI/autonomy, IT-meets-OT versatility, humanoid reliability, safety/security, labor-gap solutions
Humanoid robots must match industrial requirements on cycle times, energy, and maintenance costs to reach commercial viability
Employers globally struggle to find specialized skills — 'labor gap solutions' framing positions robots as complement not substitute
Rise in hacking attempts targeting robot controllers and cloud platforms cited as growing risk
methodology: IFR press release summarizing analysis by IFR statistical and analytical staff based on member surveys and installation data.
qualifiers: IFR is an industry federation with obvious interest in framing robotics adoption favorably. 'Labor gap' framing is common in industry-forward discourse but does not directly measure displacement.
